scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');if(fs.existsSync('web/index.html'))require('node:child_process').execFileSync(process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm',['exec','vite','--','build','--config','vite.config.ts'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:process.platform==='win32'});else console.log('Web build deferred until Task 2 creates web/index.html');"
